structured.feedback: The description is about 185 words in Markdown with clear subheadings and an active voice. Its claims come from the listing and reviews, and it leaves out the third-party-seller and 30-count complaints, links and invented quotes. Minor flaws are the loose feature/benefit split, the weak call to action, and the awkward "Pack a 60-count pack".
